findings.mechanism: connection pool size (5) is less than the number of uvicorn workers (8) and cannot accommodate concurrent DB requests, causing callers to wait for a free connection
findings.remediation: increase pool_size to at least 8 and/or set max_overflow>0 in create_async_engine
findings.arithmetic: capacity_per_worker = pool_size * (1000ms / avg_query_ms) = 5 * (1000/40) = 125 rps; with uvicorn workers=8, total capacity≈1000 rps; at request_rate>125 rps per worker, connections saturate and wait time appears
